The sealed haxe.io.Bytes|haxe.io.Bytes::get get operation calls HxBytes after evaluating raw inputs once in source order and then applying identity conversions in argument order. It fixes declared-bytes-checked bounds, a 1-byte access, not-applicable ordering, unsigned-byte-read value behavior, read-only mutation, no-new-alias aliasing, and exact-int result behavior. Nullable Int multi-byte arguments preserve present values and fail null without mutation through the OCaml target's deterministic OutsideBounds policy. Float32 rounds through IEEE-754 binary32 while Float64 preserves the admitted binary64 value; NaN classification is preserved without claiming one cross-target payload. Other Bytes and BytesData operations require separate decisions.
